context: Adds an index action to the documents API and 'simplifies' the existing lookups, per the PR summary.
explanation: show and download used to scope through current_account.documents.find(...), guaranteeing a document belongs to the caller's account. They — and the new index action — now call Document.find/Document.order directly on the unscoped model. Any authenticated user from any account can now list, view, or download any other account's documents just by knowing or guessing an id, a textbook cross-tenant IDOR. Fix: scope every lookup through current_account.documents.
